sources.title: Fine-tune - PaddleOCR Documentation
sources.snippet: The PP-OCR series models provided by PaddleOCR have excellent performance in general scenarios and can solve detection and recognition problems in most cases. In vertical scenarios, if you want to obtain better model, you can further improve the accuracy of the PP-OCR series detection and recognition models through fine-tune.
